name: Senja
desc: Collect, manage, and share testimonials with Senja.

actions.name: list_testimonials
actions.description: Retrieve all testimonials from your Senja project.

actions.name: get_testimonial
actions.description: Retrieve a specific testimonial by its ID.

actions.name: create_testimonial
actions.description: Add a new testimonial to your Senja project.

actions.name: update_testimonial
actions.description: Approve, unapprove, or update tags on an existing testimonial.

actions.name: delete_testimonial
actions.description: Permanently delete a testimonial from your Senja project. This action cannot be undone.

actions.name: custom_api_call
actions.description: Make a custom API call to a specific endpoint

triggers.name: testimonial_event
triggers.description: Triggers when a testimonial is created, updated, or deleted in Senja.
